title: [Main]]No Employee posting group for AT when new employee is created
summary: An Austrian localization issue where new employees created from templates lacked an employee posting group assignment has been fixed by applying the EMPLEXP posting group to employee templates.
key_points: ADMINISTRATION and IT employee templates now have an employee posting group assigned
The Austrian localization subscriber previously cleared the field, now it assigns EMPLEXP
Demo employees generated from these templates now receive the correct posting group
Tests added to verify posting groups on templates and generated demo employees
